text:
ren: uploaded a compact design pass for the Playground streaming flow. main goals: make interruptions feel smooth, surface token usage better, and make prompt-shelf inserts non-jarring. figs linked in thread.

julia: skimmed. big question: should Stop be destructive? propose: Stop = soft-cancel (keeps partial text editable + marks it as "partial"); Try again = restart from same prompt.

oz: perf angle: if Stop keeps a short-lived KV snapshot we can do near-instant Try again. suggest default snapshot TTL = 9s, configurable per deployment. recommend client debounce 350ms to avoid accidental double tries.

meena: accessibility: label Stop as `aria-label="Stop generation, preserve partial output"`. Announce state change with `aria-live="assertive"`: "Generation stopped; partial output kept and editable."

ren: token counter copy: prefer "Compute tokens" over "Tokens used". show a tooltip: "Estimated billed compute tokens for this conversation." Also explore a tiny live sparkline next to the counter to show per-turn token rate.

julia: placement: composer-left vs header badge. my vote: composer-left for immediate feedback during composition; reveal header badge after thread >=4 turns. mobile: use tap-to-open modal for the token breakdown.

oz: token updates should be live (throttle 200ms). clicking counter expands a compact panel with per-turn rows and an export CSV action. include a "Reset view" button to collapse.

meena: prompt shelf: two insert modes discussed: inline insert (paste into composer) and block insert (adds as a new message draft). prefer inline because it keeps edits fast. make insert keyboard-accessible (Tab to focus, Enter/Space to insert). announce insert with `aria-live=polite`: "Prompt inserted: <title>". keep focus in composer after insert.

ren: micro-interaction: animate a 180ms soft highlight on inserted text so the user sees it was injected. also add an insert API param `preserveCursor=true` to avoid caret jump.

julia: button styling: Try again should be low-emphasis outline not primary. add a subtle cooldown indicator (small circular countdown) when fast-regen is unavailable. avoid large affordance that encourages spamming.

oz: backend: server enforces per-user try-again rate limits. client shows cooldown countdown and sets `aria-disabled=true`. if KV snapshot expired, show toast: "Fast retry unavailable — warming model".

meena: keyboard map suggestion: `Esc` = Stop, `Shift+Enter` = Try again (so Enter stays send). check conflicts with screen reader commands.

ren: copy tweak for the stop toast: "Generation stopped — partial result saved. Use Try again to retry." simple and explicit for screen readers.

julia: accessibility nit: when partial output is editable, announce to screen readers that the block is editable and add a small "partial" badge with accessible name. e.g., `aria-label="Partial result, editable"`.

oz: durability: consider exposing a tenant-level config `fast_retry_ttl` so enterprise customers can tune for cost vs UX. will add to API spec.

meena: prompt library metadata: show token estimate and last-used timestamp on hover. allow users to insert without stealing focus or losing undo stack. `preserveCursor` helps here.

ren: follow-ups: owner=ren, action@oz (KV TTL + client debounce + API flag), action@julia (token counter placement + small-sparkline mock), action@meena (a11y copy + keyboard doc). will post updated figma and a tiny test plan before the design sync.

design-bot: Reminder — design sync scheduled at 1905008400 UTC. React with :white_check_mark: to confirm attendance.

ren: thanks all 1 very actionable. I'll update copy to use "Compute tokens" and "Try again" and push updated mocks later today.
